title: Garlic Butter Crusty Bread
description: Soft, golden bread with a crispy crust and a rich garlic butter topping — perfect for any meal.

method.instruction: In a large bowl, combine lukewarm milk, sugar, and instant yeast. Let sit for 5 minutes until slightly foamy.
Add the egg, Baker's flour, and salt. Mix until a rough dough forms.
Add 15g butter and knead for 8-10 minutes until the dough is smooth, elastic, and no longer sticky.
Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp tea towel, and let rise in a warm place for 1-1.5 hours or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and shape into a tight oval or log. Place in a greased loaf tin or on a lined baking tray.
Cover and let rise for another 45-60 minutes until puffy.
Meanwhile, make the garlic butter: Mix softened butter, minced garlic, honey, a pinch of salt, and chopped parsley until well combined.
Brush the top of the risen loaf lightly with milk for extra color (optional).
Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown and the loaf sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom.
Remove from oven and immediately brush the hot loaf generously with the garlic butter mixture.
Let cool for 10 minutes before slicing. Serve warm.

notes.title: Extra Crispy Crust
notes.content: For an extra-crispy crust, brush the dough lightly with milk before baking.

notes.title: Serving Suggestion
notes.content: Serve warm with extra garlic butter on the side for dipping, or alongside pasta, soups, or salads.
